conviction_note: The Q1 2026/27 numbers (Jul-Sep) have not been pre-released and no ad-hoc has come since 3 Aug, so the print is new information on a name whose last five results days moved 17.0/3.0/7.3/15.4/3.1%. abs_move is 7.0. The FY guide (EUR 210-250m EBITDA, 24 Sep) will most likely be reiterated or firmed rather than changed, because Verbio announces material guide changes by ad-hoc and has filed none. Argus's October fall in German GHG quota prices is a risk to the Q2 commentary. Those net to a +0.5 impact_sum. All three are proxies and the bar is a single broker's, so p_up sits at 53. The scaled +0.42 is close to the sum, and both are small because nothing decisive was found.

findings.finding: Suedzucker's CropEnergies segment, Europe's largest ethanol producer, earned about EUR 44m operating EBITDA in Jun-Aug 2026 (H1 EUR 68m less Q1 EUR 24m) against roughly zero a year earlier, on markedly higher renewable-ethanol prices. Two of Verbio's three Q1 months therefore saw strong European ethanol margins, which argues against the full normalisation NuWays assumes (EU ethanol spread ~EUR 230/t vs ~380 in Q4) and points to a mild Bioethanol-segment beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 13 May 2026 a quota- and margin-driven Q3 beat with a firmed outlook gave +15.4%. On 12 Nov 2025 a 'solid start' Q1 with the guide confirmed gave +3.0%.
findings.original_quote: Das operative EBITDA lag mit 68 (Vorjahr: 4) Millionen Euro deutlich über dem Vorjahr. Dabei haben sich im Berichtszeitraum deutlich höhere Preise für erneuerbares Ethanol und deutlich niedrigere Nettorohstoffkosten positiv ausgewirkt. [Translation: operating EBITDA of EUR 68m (prior year: 4m) was well above the prior year, helped by markedly higher renewable-ethanol prices and markedly lower net raw-material costs.] Q1 (Mar-May) CropEnergies EBITDA was 24 (prior year 4), per https://www.pressetext.com/news/suedzucker-mit-deutlichem-anstieg-des-operativen-ebitda-im-ersten-quartal-2026-27.html
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. NuWays published its 230 EUR/t normalisation on 21 Oct, after the Suedzucker H1 of 8 Oct, so the broker may already have weighed it. September (T2 spot reportedly fell 10-11 Sep) is not in Suedzucker's quarter. If the market fully believed in strong Jul-Sep ethanol margins, the stock would not have fallen 16% from 27 Oct to 10 Nov into a print expected to quadruple EBITDA. This is a peer proxy, not a Verbio number, and Bioethanol is about half of segment EBITDA, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The Suedzucker ad-hoc of 28 Sep 2026 attributes the Jun-Aug EBITDA jump to 'höhere Ethanolpreise' in CropEnergies (https://stock3.com/news/pta-adhoc-suedzucker-ag-suedzucker-mit-deutlichem-ergebnisanstieg-im-zweiten-quartal-2026-27-17305638). It is the same issuer, so not independent.

findings.finding: Green Plains' Q3 2026 8-K (Jul-Sep, the same months as Verbio's Q1) reports record adjusted EBITDA, improved crush margins at 95% utilisation and USD 65.4m of 45Z credit value. That points to a strong US ethanol margin quarter for Verbio North America (Nevada IA, South Bend), where NuWays models continuing losses with no tax benefit recognised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Verbio's North American ramp has been cited positively in the Q4 and FY releases. No clean prior reaction is isolated to the US line.
findings.why_not_priced: Small and partly priced. US ethanol is a minority of Verbio group EBITDA and NuWays already models Nevada's ramp. Whether Verbio recognises any 45Z value is unknown, and the transmission from GPRE to Verbio is a hypothesis. GPRE itself said Q4 margins will come in below Q3 peaks, so this does not help the forward tone.
findings.independence: MarketBeat's call summary has crush margin at ~70c/gal vs ~30c a year earlier (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-green-plains-q3-earnings-call-highlights-2026-11-05/). It is the same company, so not independent.

findings.finding: Argus reports that the price of German 'Andere' 2026 GHG quota reductions fell by more than EUR 69.50/t CO2e between 1 Oct and mid-October, after months of rising prices, alongside falling ARA HVO premiums and cheaper biodiesel. That is a risk to Verbio's Q2 quota realisations and biodiesel tone in the outlook commentary, even though Q1 itself benefited from the rising prices.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GHG quota prices have been the stock's main driver: the rally to EUR 44 in March 2026 came on quota normalisation, and the 24 Sep 2026 guide set below consensus cost -3.1%.
findings.original_quote: Maßgeblich hierfür war der Rückgang der für die Kalkulation relevanten Minderungen der Kategorie "Andere" 2026, deren Preis seit dem 1. Oktober um mehr als 69,50 €/t CO2e nachgegeben hat. Der jüngste Rückgang ist dabei sowohl auf niedrigere Kosten des Erwerbs von THG-Minderungen als auch auf günstigeren Biodiesel zurückzuführen. [Translation: the main factor was the fall in 2026 'Other' category reductions, whose price has fallen by more than EUR 69.50/t CO2e since 1 October; the drop reflects both lower costs of acquiring GHG reductions and cheaper biodiesel.]
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The stock fell from EUR 30.56 on 27 Oct to 25.52 on 10 Nov with no company news, which is consistent with the market reading quota softness. What is not yet known is whether management will quantify it or soften the tone on the call. NuWays expects realised prices to stay stable on fixed-price bilateral contracts, so the earnings transmission is partial. This is a market series rather than a company number, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Commercial THG-premium portals were still quoting higher payouts in October (https://www.e-mobileo.de/thg-oktober-2026/), so the evidence is mixed and nothing independent confirms the decline.

outside_window.finding: The German Cabinet (28 Oct 2026) amended the Biokraft-NachV to end reliance protection on sustainability certificates (anti-fraud). It is structurally positive for Verbio but needs further legislative steps and cannot resolve on 12 Nov; the stock fell 1.5% on the day of Verbio's release.
The AGM on 4 Dec 2026 votes on new authorised capital (genehmigtes Kapital), flagged as a 'Kapitalerhöhung im Anmarsch?' overhang in the German press. The vote falls after the window.

Germany's E20 proposal (Transport Minister Bilger, mid-October 2026). NuWays sensitivity: +EUR 100/t ethanol margin is about EUR 33m EBITDA a year. There is no formal proposal or timetable, and 2027 at the earliest.

baseline_tension: The small net positive agrees weakly with the slightly positive priced_lean (+0.16), which is just the run-up given no register anchor. It cuts against the six-week slide, which the October GHG price fall already partly explains.
language_note: Suedzucker's German half-year and Q1 releases (pressetext) gave the CropEnergies segment EBITDA by quarter, which lets Jun-Aug ethanol margins be derived as ~EUR 44m vs ~0. No English wire carried the segment split.
Argus's German-language report (Sinkende THG-Erfüllungskosten) carried the >EUR 69.50/t CO2e fall in 2026 'Andere' quota prices since 1 Oct. Nothing in the English search returned it.
